_comment: Structured store for highest-stakes CMU-Q facts (deadlines, amounts, GPA cutoffs, credit limits). To add an entry: copy the object shape below (omit _comment), pick a stable camelCase id, write a short searchable topic phrase (used by checkKeyFacts keyword matching), set value to the exact approved wording, lastVerified to ISO date when you confirmed it, and source to a human-readable label (not a file path). Restart the server after editing.

value: TAFAWQ merit scholarship requires a cumulative GPA of 4.0.
TAMAIYUZ scholarship requires a cumulative GPA of 3.8 or higher.
TAFAWQ scholarship application fee is QAR 183 (50 USD), paid upon application submission.
TAMAIYUZ scholarship application cycle is open from 15 May 2026 until 5 June 2026.

Students may register for a course overload of up to 12 units with academic advisor approval. Overloads above 12 units require advisor approval and an S3 maximum-units adjustment (available no earlier than the Saturday after Registration Week).
Fall 2026 Education City cross-registration forms are accepted starting July 1, 2026. The submission deadline is August 1, 2026.
CMU-Q students may cross-register for one course per semester at another Education City university.

value: For hosted students cross-registering at CMU-Q, the add period ends on the 10th day of class.

value: A $30 replacement fee applies for all lost CMU ID cards.
Residents incur a penalty fee of $200 for violating fire-safety guidelines.
Plaid Cash has a maximum deposit amount of $2,000.
A processing fee of $25 is assessed for Plaid Cash refunds.

Minor declaration forms should be submitted at least two weeks prior to registration week to be considered for available spaces in non-major courses. Students are encouraged to declare no later than the end of sophomore year.
